body:
This is the final release of opam 2.6.0.

Binaries and full archive are signed by the [opam dev team](https://opam.ocaml.org/opam-dev-pubkey.pgp) (fingerprint `92C5 26AE 50DF 3947 0EB2 911B ED4C F1CA 67CB AA92`).
To verify the authenticity of one of these files, run the following commands:
```
curl -fsSLO https://opam.ocaml.org/opam-dev-pubkey.pgp
gpg --import opam-dev-pubkey.pgp
gpg --verify *.sig
```

[Changelog](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/blob/2.6.0/CHANGES):

## Changes

* Bump `opam-root-version` to 2.6 [#7146 @kit-ty-kate]
* Improve and extend the testsuite [#7146 @kit-ty-kate @rjbou]

To get the detailed list of changes compared to 2.5.2, you can look at the pre-releases' release notes:
- [the release note for 2.6.0~alpha1](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/releases/tag/2.6.0-alpha1)
- [the release note for 2.6.0~beta1](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/releases/tag/2.6.0-beta1)
- [the release note for 2.6.0~beta2](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/releases/tag/2.6.0-beta2)
- [the release note for 2.6.0~rc1](https://github.com/ocaml/opam/releases/tag/2.6.0-rc1)

**For a more descriptive and simplified list of changes, please read our [blog post](https://opam.ocaml.org/blog/opam-2-6-0/).**

---
**Special thanks to the Haematology department and Bone Marrow Transplant Unit of the NHS Greater Glasgow for making this release possible <3**
